name: throughline
description: Your agentic design team. Design screens in Figma on your own design system or on a library your team already uses, or build a design system from scratch and sync it to code: tokens, components, docs and screens from one source, with checks that stop the build when something slips.

figma_access_token.title: Figma access token
figma_access_token.description: Optional. A Figma personal access token (starts with figd_) for the few Figma calls the Desktop Bridge can't make, such as reading a published library. Leave it blank to work through the bridge only.
